title: Sloth holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q64 50 58 60 Q54 68 52 72' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='24' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='19' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='62,36 66,36 64,40' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='18' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#D4A574'/>
  
  <!-- Left arm (reaching up to balloon string) -->
  <path d='M30 60 Q38 50 50 55 Q54 58 52 62' fill='none' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M54 62 Q60 60 62 56' fill='none' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Hand holding string -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='60' r='4' fill='#A0714F'/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='82' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7A4E2E'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='82' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7A4E2E'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#A0714F'/>
  
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#D4A574'/>
  
  <!-- Eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='49' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='49' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='49' r='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M39 58 Q42 61 45 58' fill='none' stroke='#5C3A1E' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='44' r='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='44' r='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  
  <!-- Head tuft -->
  <path d='M40 36 Q42 32 44 36' fill='none' stroke='#A0714F' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
